project_type: React SPA (Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind) - Manga translation app
test_framework: Vitest (but tests are NOT to be added per user request)
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build
verification_instructions: Run npm run typecheck && npm run build. Both must pass with zero errors.
setup_instructions: npm install (already done), then npm install jspdf jszip for new deps
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: No tests required. Typecheck + build must pass. Create feature branch, commit, push, open PR against main.
key_patterns: Zustand stores in store/ dir. IndexedDB service in services/imageStorage.ts (DB_VERSION=2, stores: images, fonts). downloadCanvas.ts renders pages to canvas (reusable for PDF/ZIP). useToastStore for notifications. Sidebar in App.tsx with history list. Components use Tailwind + heroicons. Session state NOT persisted currently (useSessionStore is ephemeral per-tab).
directory_structure: Root: App.tsx, index.tsx, types.ts. components/ (MangaViewer, BubbleOverlay, Uploader, ui/). features/ (translator/, viewer/, settings/). services/ (imageStorage.ts, blobUrls.ts, libraryService.ts, api/). store/ (zustand stores). backend/ (proxy server).
